tool_args.rationale: The archive identifies a linear leak as an alternative to the square-root local branch. Both are linear in their effective coefficients and can be fitted numerically to the existing observations before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The previous confirmation refuted the fitted saturating-base model; allowing the square-root coefficient either sign tests the alternative branch.
Not rejected: fitted alongside the square-root branch and selected if its training residual is smaller.
Nine observations already span substrate and gradient; the archive supplies a concrete untested branch, while the nuisance reading is irrelevant.
